hotspots.title: Manuel Adorni’s corruption scandal deepens
hotspots.blurb: Argentina’s Chief of Staff Manuel Adorni faces intense scrutiny after admitting to undeclared savings and Bitcoin investments in his sworn asset declarations. Opposition parties and allies alike demand his resignation, while President Javier Milei publicly backs him despite internal tensions.
hotspots.affect: This scandal commands disproportionate attention due to its moral charge, polarized contention, and the perceived threat to the government’s anti-corruption narrative.

hotspots.title: AfD’s internal extremism controversies
hotspots.blurb: Germany’s far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) faces escalating backlash over extremist ties, including alleged Kremlin connections, anti-democratic rhetoric, and violent protests. Mainstream parties and civil society groups intensify efforts to counter the AfD’s influence ahead of regional elections.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is charged due to alarmist framing, cross-source repetition, and fears of democratic erosion linked to the AfD’s rise.
